cards.heading: Objects and key/value pairs
cards.body: JSON data is built from objects: curly braces holding key/value pairs separated by commas. Keys are always strings in double quotes, followed by a colon.

cards.heading: Value types
cards.body: A value is a string ("text" in double quotes), a number (42, 3.5, no quotes), a boolean (true or false, lowercase), null, an array ([ ] an ordered list) or another object.

cards.heading: Nesting and reading paths
cards.body: Objects and arrays nest, so you follow a path one step at a time. interfaces[1].ipv4.address means: the key interfaces, its second item (arrays count from 0), then ipv4, then address.

cards.heading: Strict rules
cards.body: Double quotes only, never single. A comma between items but not after the last one. Lowercase true/false/null. No comments. Whitespace and line breaks don't matter.
